title: Budget honestly: procedural materials plateau at 5-7/10 on photoreal AI references
summary: Three matches stopped at the budget: 7, 7, 5/10 with 0 issues. Procedural canvas materials plateau at 5-7 on photoreal AI references; 8+ needs PBR/scanned textures and some GI.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: stop rule: critic >= 8 with ISSUES 0, or the pass budget (~15-20 at 40-60 s), or a plateau (two critics within ±.5)

doc.when: Planning or stopping a match loop; promising quality to a user.
doc.avoid: Spending passes 15-30 on procedural textures expecting 8/10.
gotchas: Fetch CC0 PBR textures when the target is photoreal.

problem.symptom: Scores stall at 5-7 while passes keep going.
problem.cause: Canvas textures + direct lights can't reach photoreal soil, cloth, rust and GI bounce.
problem.fix: Stop at the budget or plateau; switch to scanned/PBR textures or accept the ceiling.
